case_name: The Helios Pharma Clinical Trial Discrepancy

planted_contradictions.topic: Continuous minus 80 C vs warming to plus 4 C
planted_contradictions.statement_a: Yes, absolutely. Freezer Unit 4 maintained strict minus 80 Celsius throughout the August testing window.

planted_contradictions.topic: Generator kicked in seamlessly vs generator failed for nearly six hours
planted_contradictions.statement_a: The backup diesel generator kicked in seamlessly during the August 14 storm.
planted_contradictions.statement_b: The backup generator failed to engage for nearly six hours. The digital display on Freezer Unit 4 rose to plus 4 Celsius between 2:00 AM and 7:45 AM.

planted_contradictions.topic: Dispatched at 08:00 AM vs delayed pickup at 14:30 PM
planted_contradictions.statement_a: They were dispatched via CryoExpress courier on August 16 at 08:00 AM under dry ice.
planted_contradictions.statement_b: Pickup Timestamp: 2024-08-16 14:30:00 (Delayed from morning due to missing dry ice replenishment)

correct_hypothesis.title: Deliberate Concealment of Temperature Excursion by Principal Investigator
correct_hypothesis.description: Dr. Arlo Kaufman knowingly concealed the 5.5-hour cryogenic failure of Freezer Unit 4, ordered the paper logs suppressed, and administered degraded Batch HL-902B to patients to avoid milestone delays.

decoy_hypotheses.title: Courier Handling Failure During CryoExpress Transit
decoy_hypotheses.description: The drug degraded exclusively during shipping because driver Raymond Vance failed to replenish dry ice.

decoy_hypotheses.title: Unforeseeable Biological Idiosyncrasy in Cohort 3 Patients
decoy_hypotheses.description: Patient adverse reactions were caused by unexpected genetic hypersensitivity rather than drug degradation.
